scripts.dev:api: uv run python -c "import uvicorn; from pulso_core.settings import get_settings; uvicorn.run('pulso_api.main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=get_settings().api_port, reload=True, reload_dirs=['apps/api/src', 'packages/core/src'])"
scripts.db:migrate: uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.gen:api: uv run python -m pulso_api.openapi && pnpm --dir apps/web exec openapi-typescript ../api/openapi.json --output src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.test: uv run pytest && pnpm --filter web test
